title: Units of measure: decide whether a deleted org unit code stays retired or can be created again (ADR-0158 Open item 11)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Routed by [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md#open-items), Open item 11, to the `sys_unit` card. Parent: #35339 (ADR merged in PR #35370, 35bd36082c).

## Defect the ADR names
L1 allows deleting an org unit and makes a unit's code and dimension immutable after create. That does not survive a delete followed by a new create of the same code: a `sys_*` row has no recycle bin and frees its unique value at once (ADR-0148: "Unique keys free immediately", v1 covers business objects only). The same code can then come back with another dimension, ratio and label. Rows resting on the old unit keep the code, take the new label in R1's display, fall into one group with the new unit's rows under U7 R1's grouped aggregate, and can sit under a `unitDimension` they no longer satisfy. That is the relabel hazard ADR-0144 D4 closed for currency. L1 rules out scanning for "used", so a use check cannot close it.

## Done when
The `sys_unit` card picks one: a deleted code stays retired (refused on re-create), or re-creation is admitted and its consequence for resting rows is stated; ADR-0158 is amended. Sibling: Open item 2, filed beside this one under #35339.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:spec. Silent regrouping and relabelling of stored quantities if left open when `sys_unit` ships.
